text: The criterion says a `list_patches` call in a `context_type='patch'` thread ends with the error "Tool not available in this context". As with `runTransagent` (dev-0001), that wording is produced by the agent runtime for a tool no registered server carries, not by claude4spec, and cannot be asserted without the real runtime. Assumed: the criterion is met by the app guaranteeing non-registration — the patch turn's `mcpServers` has no `transagent-tools` (the only server rendering `list_patches`), no mounted server lists `list_patches`, and `patch-tools` carries only `get_patch` / `mark_patch_applied` — asserted by `[ac:ac-wywolanie-list-patches-w-watku-contex]` in src/server/routes/agent-turn.test.ts. Suggest the title name the non-registration as the observable, or say "błędem narzędzia niedostępnego (np. „Tool not available in this context”)".
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0002 — the error text is the agent runtime's answer to a call on an unregistered tool; the app guarantees the non-registration, not the wording.
